description: This file defines React components for a breadcrumb navigation UI, including structure and styling details.

methods.name: Breadcrumb
methods.description: React component rendering a <nav> element for breadcrumb navigation.

methods.name: BreadcrumbList
methods.description: React component rendering an ordered list (<ol>) for breadcrumb items with styling and slot data attribute.

methods.name: BreadcrumbItem
methods.description: React component rendering a list item (<li>) for individual breadcrumb entries.

methods.name: BreadcrumbLink
methods.description: React component rendering a link, optionally as a child of another component, with styling and accessibility attributes.

methods.name: BreadcrumbPage
methods.description: React component representing the current page in the breadcrumb as a span with role and aria attributes.

methods.name: BreadcrumbSeparator
methods.description: React component for rendering the separator (e.g., arrow icon) between breadcrumb items.

methods.name: BreadcrumbEllipsis
methods.description: React component rendering an ellipsis symbol indicating additional hidden breadcrumb items.
